acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition mode was used to trigger precursor isolation and sequencing.
alkylation_concentration: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups by incubating the vials in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.
alkylation_reagent: DTT and iodoacetamide (IAA) were purchased from Thermo Scientific (St. Louis, MO, USA) and freshly prepared in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer each day before use.
cleavage_agent: Trypsin (MS grade) and Lys-C (MS grade) were products of Promega (Madison, WI, USA).
collision_energy: Precursor ions with charges of +2 to +7 were isolated with an m/z window of 2 and fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
fragmentation_method: Precursor ions with charges of +2 to +7 were isolated with an m/z window of 2 and fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
instrument: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
ionization_type: Electrospray voltage of 1.9 kV was applied at the source.
mass_analyzer: A full MS scan range of 375–1575 and Orbitrap resolution of 120,000 (at m/z 200) was used for all samples.
ptm: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification.
reduction_concentration: For sample preparation of cultured cells, 50-nL RapiGest (0.2%) solution with 10 mM DTT in 50 mM ABC was added to the nanodroplets that had been preloaded with cells.
reduction_reagent: DTT and iodoacetamide (IAA) were purchased from Thermo Scientific (St. Louis, MO, USA) and freshly prepared in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer each day before use.
